🧠 2. Copy-Paste Is Not Learning
We’ve all done it.
Stack Overflow → copy → paste → “It works.”
But if you don’t understand why it works, you’re just delaying the problem.
I used to rely heavily on copying solutions. It felt fast.
But later, when similar problems came up… I was stuck again.
If you can’t explain your code, you don’t really know it.
Now I follow a simple rule:
👉 After using any solution, I take time to understand it.
Even 5–10 minutes of deep thinking beats hours of blind coding.
